period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own unaudited interim financial statement PDF for this quarter, downloaded directly from the bank's live website (tblbd.com/reports/financial-statements/). SOLO / Bank-only basis (same basis as this dataset's main Q4/annual series and as the 2013-2016 interim filings sourced the same way): this source document explicitly separates a 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'/'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account' section (pp.2,4-6) from a plain 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' section headed just 'TRUST BANK PLC.' (pp.7,9-11); the SOLO section is the one used here -- confirmed by exact match between this PDF's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Assets 620,113,821,401) and this dataset's stored 2025_Q4.json total_assets (620113.82m). This is a BASIS IMPROVEMENT over 2017-2025's Q1-Q3 quarters in this dataset, which were sourced from the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table and are CONSOLIDATED basis (a mismatch with the main series, flagged in each of those files) -- 2026 Q1 reverts to the bank's own primary SOLO filing, matching the main series basis directly with no gap to reconcile. EXTRACTION METHOD: this PDF is a pure scanned image (NAPS2-produced, pdftotext -layout returns 0 lines on every page, confirmed via pdffonts showing zero embedded fonts) -- rather than tesseract OCR, figures were read directly by visual inspection of 200dpi page renders (pdftoppm), which is more reliable than OCR for a document this dense with similar-looking numbers; this is the 'direct visual page-reads when OCR itself is unreliable' fallback documented in the project handoff. Balance-sheet items are the 31-March-2026 period-end snapshot (unaudited); income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1, but since Q1 is the first quarter of the year this is numerically identical to the discrete quarter (both the P&L's own column, headed '1 January to 31 March 2026', and Q1 itself run Jan-Mar) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix per project convention for consistency with later quarters. Unlike the 2017-2025 CONSOLIDATED interim table, this primary filing has NO loan-classification/NPL note and NO capital-adequacy (CAR/CRAR) note anywhere in its 15 pages (confirmed by reading every page) -- npl_pct and car_pct are therefore gaps for this quarter, not omissions; this matches the 2013-2016 solo interim filings from the same source, which also lacked these notes. VALIDATED: balance-sheet identity holds exactly (Total Liabilities 618,208,995,201 + Total Equity 29,050,821,546 = Total Assets 647,259,816,747); Total Operating Income (4,984,888,582) - Total Operating Expenses (2,274,415,669) = Profit Before Provision (2,710,472,913) exactly; Profit Before Provision - Total Provision (1,539,055,000) = Total Profit Before Taxes (1,171,417,913) exactly; PBT - Total Tax (858,088,247) = Net Profit After Taxation (313,329,666) exactly; NAV per share (Section 8, Solo) of 29.22 = Total Shareholders' Equity (29,050,821,546) / 994,079,482 shares outstanding, matches the filing's own reported figure exactly.
